name: newsh2-127
summary: Purple armoured shield craft flying nose down the screen: a broad, shield-shaped hard-surface hull, wide and square-shouldered at the back and narrowing to a teal nose block. Stacked armour plates (two big shoulder plates across the back, curved cheek plates and a pale keel plate down the middle) with crisp chamfered edges, a framed cyan glass panel at the back edge, a blue glass cockpit in the middle, a twin-rod yoke between them and round ports cut into the flanks.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: blue glass block (cols 10-14, rows 9-12) clearly raised above the hull, the highest point of the centre
glossy glass with crisp chamfered edges, set in a dark frame (col 9/15, rows 8 and 13)
grey frame bar across it at row 10
bright lower edge at row 12 is its front chamfer catching the light, not a separate lump
features.note: The baseline reads this as a vent grille of slats; the concept reads it as the cockpit glass. Must read as one faceted glass canopy in a frame.

traits: rectangular cyan glass panel across the back edge (cols 9-15, rows 1-3)
set in a purple frame (cols 8 and 16, row 4), glass just below the frame rim
two darker mullions at cols 10 and 14
angular, not a dome or lens
features.note: The baseline's canopy ellipsoid; the concept draws it as a framed, lit glass panel between the shoulder plates.

traits: big raised armour plate over the back-left corner, following the hull outline
flat top over cols 5-8 (the light band), sloping down to the outer edge
crisp chamfered edges; its lower edge is the dark seam at row 6
one of the tallest parts of the craft
features.note: Concept: the heavy pauldron-like plates across the back. Mirror of shoulder-plate-right.

traits: mirror of the left shoulder plate
drawn darker in the sprite only because it is in shadow; same shape and colour
features.note: The dark pixels under it at row 6-7 (cols 15-18) are the seam/shadow below its edge.

traits: two light raised armour plates flanking the cockpit (cols 5-8 and 16-18, rows 8-13)
curving in at the bottom towards the keel (rows 14-17)
flat tops with chamfered edges, separated from the cockpit frame by a dark seam (col 9/15)
features.note: The baseline's light cheek ridges (soft capsules); concept: curved plates bracketing the keel.

traits: pale raised plate down the middle below the cockpit (cols 9-14, rows 14-19)
flat, sloping slightly down towards the nose
lit left edge (col 9) is a bevel, not a stripe
teal block at the nose (cols 9-14, rows 23-26), narrowing to the front
top sloping down to the front; light top-back edge at row 23 is a chamfer
a small dark vent slot at col 12 row 25
sits in a purple hull lip (row 22)
features.note: Baseline: teal gun block; concept: teal nose cowl with vents.

traits: three round ports per side: by the hull edge (rows 11-13), lower flank (rows 15-16) and beside the keel (rows 18-20)
dark discs cut into the hull inside a raised rim, not black lumps sticking out
the same on both sides
features.note: Concept: round turbine ports in the flanks. The baseline had protruding black ellipsoids.

traits: two light rods (cols 11 and 13, rows 5-7) joining the rear glass panel to the cockpit
round, about 1 px thick, with a dark gap (col 12) between them
in the channel between the shoulder plates
features.note: The baseline's spine; the concept draws a yoke linkage here.

traits: dark slot across the craft between the keel plate and the nose block (rows 20-21)
sunk below the plates either side
features.note: Concept: a recessed gap holding the nose mechanism.

traits: shield outline: square shoulders at the back (cols 1-23, rows 4-13), tapering to the nose
faceted hard surface with flat top and chamfered flanks, not a soft blob
dark purple flanks outside the plates
features.note: The body everything is mounted on.
